battle.policy: Predeclared teaching choices: both set up; Gardevoir tests special Psychic STAB into combined Psychic/Fighting typing, while Gallade targets physical Defense with super-effective Ghost priority. Gardevoir then plans stronger Fairy STAB but priority can deny it. Not optimal-play proof; all engine rolls kept at stable slot seed.

script.title: Gardevoir vs Gallade: Why Speed Was Not Enough

segments.title: MATCHUP
segments.text: Gardevoir faces Gallade. Psychic power meets physical precision. Let us battle.

segments.title: CALM MIND
segments.text: Gardevoir moves first and uses Calm Mind, raising Special Attack and Special Defense.
segments.note: SPEED 284 VS 196 / SP. ATK +1 / SP. DEF +1

segments.title: SWORDS DANCE
segments.text: Gallade answers with Swords Dance. Its physical Attack doubles. Gardevoir has boosted the wrong defense against this attacker.

segments.title: SHADOW SNEAK
segments.text: Shadow Sneak has plus-one priority, so Gallade jumps ahead. Ghost is super effective against Psychic. It removes sixty-eight percent.

segments.title: PSYCHIC
segments.text: Gardevoir returns Psychic. Same-type bonus applies, but Fighting weakness and Psychic resistance cancel out. Neutral damage removes forty-two percent.

segments.title: SHADOW SNEAK
segments.text: Gardevoir plans super-effective Moonblast. But another Shadow Sneak strikes first, removing its last one hundred ten HP. Moonblast never happens.

segments.title: GALLADE WINS
segments.text: Gallade wins with fifty-eight percent health. Priority and physical damage beat the special setup in this planned example. This is not a universal ranking.
